biotools.summary: Gelyze is a web-based image analysis tool for agarose gel electrophoresis of nucleic acids. A user uploads a gel image, confirms the proposed lane positions and the ladder baseline, and a deterministic algorithm then estimates fragment size from ladder calibration and quantifies relative band intensity by densitometry. Measurement and interpretation are kept separate: the numbers come from the algorithm, and an assistive AI layer explains the resulting pattern in plain language without producing any of the values. For research use only.
